subject: Request: DPIA / Art.28 / Art.30 evidence for Acme Payments
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <dpo@acme-payments.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Legal <legal@acme-payments.com>
Date: 2025-10-09T09:12:00+01:00
Subject: Request: privacy evidence for upcoming DPIA - Acme Payments

Hi Kimberly / Marissa,

We are starting a DPIA for a new product line and Acme's privacy team needs to assemble vendor evidence for the data flows that touch Redwood. Specifically, could you provide the following artifacts by 2025-10-20:

- Current list of subprocessors (Art.28) including country of processing and purpose
- Article 30 records of processing relating to Acme (or confirmation these are covered centrally)
- Confirmation of transfer mechanisms (SCCs / BCR / adequacy) used for EU->US transfers and the specific subprocessors using them
- Any DPIA / TIA notes Redwood can share that are non-privileged and redacted for vendor names if required
- SOC 2 Type 2 (redacted OK) and a summary of relevant controls for processing/payment data
- Executed DPA (we only have a PDF with initials — need the fully executed copy)

Can you confirm whether you can share a consolidated "audit packet" (zip or shared Drive) and whether a short sync (30 min) next week would help?

Many thanks,
Lena Ortiz
DPO, Acme Payments
lena.ortiz@acme-payments.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <dpo@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-09T11:02:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Request: privacy evidence for upcoming DPIA - Acme Payments

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble an "audit packet" and share a Drive folder. Quick notes:

- I have asked Marissa to pull the latest subprocessor inventory and the Art.30/processing map entries relevant to Acme.
- Laura (legal) is on copy to confirm the executed DPA and SCC posture.
- We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type 2 and a controls summary; the formal SOC report will be a redacted PDF (confidential).
- For transfers: Redwood uses SCCs with our US-hosted subprocessor pool plus some EU-hosted subprocessors (we will annotate which ones rely on SCCs). If any subprocessor relies on a BCR, we'll flag it (rare).

Attachments I'll put into the folder initially: a checklist template (so you can confirm nothing else is needed) and a preliminary subprocessor extract.

Would 2025-10-14 09:30 UK time work for a 30-minute sync? If yes, we'll send a calendar invite.

- Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Compliance Ops | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_audit_packet_checklist.pdf (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Lena Ortiz <dpo@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-10T08:15:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Request: privacy evidence for upcoming DPIA - Acme Payments

Thanks — attaching the subprocessor inventory extract specific to Acme's processing paths. Notes:

- Column headings: subprocessor_name, service_purpose, processing_country, transfers_to_us (yes/no), uses_scc (yes/no), contract_signed (yes/no)
- We included a flag if the subprocessor performs any persistent storage of Acme data (important for retention).
- One subprocessor (EdgeCache EU) processes in the EU and does not transfer to the US; all others either process in US (SCC) or are EU-resident.

I'll follow up with a CSV: subprocessor_inventory_2025-10.csv attached. Laura — can you confirm whether the SCCs we have in place for the US-hosted pool are the latest 2021 modules, and whether an MCP addendum was used for the DSPs?

- Marissa
Data Privacy Operations
Marissa Cole | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: subprocessor_inventory_2025-10.csv (stub)

From: Samir Rao <samir@acme-payments.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <dpo@acme-payments.com>, Acme Legal <legal@acme-payments.com>
Date: 2025-10-11T10:47:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Request: privacy evidence for upcoming DPIA - Acme Payments

Kimberly — thanks for the quick coordination. A couple of clarifications from Acme legal:

1) We need the Art.30 record entries specifically stating the categories of data you process for Acme (e.g., payment tokens, transaction metadata, customer identifiers) and the retention schedule for each category.
2) The SOC2 redacted report is fine, but please include a short control mapping indicating which controls we can rely on for encryption at-rest, key management, and logging/monitoring of access to production data.
3) For SCCs: if you could indicate which subprocessors are covered by your controller-processor SCCs vs processor-processor wording that would be helpful.

Deadline still stands for 2025-10-20; if we can get a Drive link and the DPA fully executed copy beforehand that helps our legal sign-off.

Best,
Samir Rao
Security & Compliance Partner
Acme Payments

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <dpo@acme-payments.com>, Samir Rao <samir@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-12T16:45:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Request: privacy evidence for upcoming DPIA - Acme Payments

Lena / Samir — action summary and deliverables below. We uploaded everything to a restricted Drive folder and shared a link (see related_links). Items included in the audit packet:

- redwood_audit_packet_checklist.pdf (checklist; index of contents)
- subprocessor_inventory_2025-10.csv (inventory filtered for Acme-related processors)
- SOC2-type2-redacted-2025.pdf (redacted copy)
- Controls mapping (inline in the Drive folder: controls_map_encryption_logging.md)
- Executed DPA: DPA-executed-acme.pdf (fully executed; internal signatures included)
- Summary note on transfer mechanisms: transfer_summary_2025-10.pdf (SCCs for US transfers; no BCRs used)

Notes / next steps:
- Laura confirms SCCs used are the 2021 EU Commission module and that processor-processor language is used where Redwood is acting as a subprocessors gateway; we will annotate the CSV accordingly.
- If you need further redaction on the SOC report, let us know which sections to mask; we can produce an additional redacted version.
- I scheduled a 30-minute sync for 2025-10-14 09:30 UK time and sent a calendar invite.

If anything is missing from your side, please highlight items in the checklist directly in the Drive folder and we'll add or escalate to Legal.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Compliance Ops | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachment: DPA-executed-acme.pdf (stub)
